text.formatted: The hezrou has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
text.plain: The hezrou has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

text.formatted: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the hezrou must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be Poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the hezrou's stench for 24 hours.
text.plain: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the hezrou must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be Poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the hezrou's stench for 24 hours.

text.formatted: The hezrou makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.
